title: Lucille Hegeman and Alberta Hunter on television
summary: She briefly places Lucille Hegeman and enjoys seeing Alberta Hunter honored on television.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you know Lucille Hegeman (PHONETIC)?
Was she a friend of yours?
No, she wasn't actually a friend of mine, but I knew (unintelligible).
When you saw Alberta Hunter (PHONETIC) on the television, how did that -- how did you find that? How did you like that?
I thought it was great. I seen (unintelligible), they give her a award. Did you see it?
You thought it was nice, wasn't it?
It reminded me of mine. It was just like mine, wasn't it?
